root.label: Israeli destruction in Beit Ummar and Nahalin

events.label: Israeli destruction in Beit Ummar and Nahalin

slots.name: Demolition losses
slots.sentence: Israeli forces also destroyed four water wells and several greenhouses in nearby Beit Ummar in Hebron in the occupied West Bank, causing an estimated $60,000 in losses, and demolished a home in Nahalin in Bethlehem governorate.
